data.export.body: A single ZIP file with your mail, files, calendars, contacts, notes, documents, photos and messages. Anything that already has a standard format goes as it is: emails as .eml, calendars as .ics, contacts as .vcf and files just as you uploaded them.

data.export.formatHelp: The lists describe what is in the copy: your messages, events, contacts or files, one per row.
data.export.orgHelp: Each copy belongs to one organisation. If you choose another, you switch to it and the download starts on its own.
data.export.scope: The copy includes the data of the organisation you are signed in to. The summary file inside says what was included from each app.
data.export.startedBody: Your browser keeps saving it even if you close this page. If you have many files, it will take a while.
data.export.xml: For systems that ask for XML.
data.lead: Download a copy of everything you have in Sytue One, whenever you want and without asking anyone.
data.move.body: To send it straight to Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, without downloading anything: if your account is personal or you administer your organisation, start it yourself from Sytue Admin, in Migrations; otherwise, ask whoever administers it.

privacy.notice: We do not sell your data or share it with third parties. We do not use it to profile you, for advertising, or to train or improve our services or anyone else’s. It is encrypted in transit and at rest, and only leaves our European infrastructure where strictly needed to bill you and in the integrations you enable, where the third party will ask your approval for the data it will use.
